title: 第22章 你的攻击已经结束现在轮到我了第23章 生死战我为何要住手
slug: 吞噬古帝第6589章炼化雷城
lines: 邢映雪很是著急和担心，生怕苏学弟答应唐昊的生死战。
一旦签订生死约，就算唐昊杀了苏辰，相信学院也不会插手此事，这便是学院的规矩。
正是因为如此。
不到生死恩怨的情况下，相信没有人愿意签订生死约。
苏辰点点头，笑著说道：“乐意奉陪。”
话音刚落。
两人各自逼出一滴精血，在半空之中融合一起，形成一股奇异的力量，正是生死约。
生死约刚刚签订，两人身上同时爆发出强悍霸道的气势，各自凝聚出的血轮仰天咆哮。
冰冷的双眼蕴含著森冷杀意，唐昊根本未將此人放在眼里，就算苏辰是八级筑基境又能如何，相差整整两个阶位，並且他觉醒的还是麒麟锤血轮。
两人的身影同时动了，穿透层层空间，狠狠地碰撞在一起。
没有丝毫的轻视，苏辰很清楚，自己能够击败虚丹境，不代表一定可以镇压任何筑基境。
有些妖孽的筑基境武者，实力未必会比自己差。
这里是东荒学院，他拥有三血轮的事情，肯定不会传出去。
手里出现麒麟锤，化作数十丈，直接朝著苏辰狠狠地砸来，麒麟锤血轮本身就是走的力量型，最直接的锤。
“苏学弟，小心。”
以九劫剑诀融入剑血轮之中，手里出现的黑红色剑影，同样朝著唐昊劈了出去。
剑锤狠狠地碰撞，顿时引起波动蔓延四周，地面无法承受碰撞，开始寸寸碎裂。
两人同时后退，苏辰只是退了一步，唐昊却足足退了六七步，骇然的眼神里写满了震惊，他万万没有想到，苏辰竟然能够硬扛下来。
他对自己的实力有著十足信心。
不仅可以横扫同级，更是可以越级杀敌，仗著手里的麒麟锤血轮，更是能够击败四级虚丹境。
现在呢？
连连后退数步，第一次的碰撞，严格来说他已经输了，却不愿意认输。
“让你见识一下，我唐族的麒麟锤决。”
犹如鬼魅一般瞬间消失在原地，手里的麒麟锤再次狠狠地挥舞起来，一锤接著一锤，连绵不断的锤影铺天盖地地席捲而来。
“我身如剑！”
苏辰站在原地不动，手里的剑原地施展，密密麻麻的霸道剑气形成剑罩。
砰！
砰砰！
凌厉霸道的锤影不断地轰击在剑罩上，速度不断地飆升起来。
双拳紧紧握著，满脸担心地死死盯著面前一幕，苏学弟绝对不能有事，否则的话，她这一辈子都不会感到心安。
愧疚一生。
她却无法插手，毕竟她的实力根本不足以抗衡唐昊，只能希望苏学弟胜出。
“小子，我倒要看看，你能够抵挡住我的几锤。”
如沙尘暴般狠狠地轰击著，密密麻麻的锤影笼罩了剑罩，已经看不到苏辰的身影，只能看见来回挥舞麒麟锤的唐昊。
content_en:
Xing Yingxue was very anxious and worried, fearing that Junior Su would agree to Tang Hao's life and death battle.
Once a life and death contract is signed, even if Tang Hao kills Su Chen, I believe the college will not interfere in the matter. This is the rule of the college.
That's why.
Unless there is a life-and-death grudge, I believe no one would be willing to sign a life-and-death contract.
Su Chen nodded, smiled and said, "I'm happy to accompany you."
The words just fell.
The two of them each forced out a drop of blood essence and merged together in mid-air to form a strange force, which was a life-and-death covenant.
The life-and-death contract had just been signed, and a powerful and domineering aura erupted from both of them at the same time, and the blood wheels they had condensed roared upward to the sky.
The cold eyes contained cold murderous intent. Tang Hao didn't take this person seriously at all. So what if Su Chen was at the eighth level of foundation building? There was a whole two levels difference, and what he had awakened was the Qilin Hammer Blood Wheel.
The two figures moved at the same time, penetrating through the layers of space and colliding hard together.
Without the slightest contempt, Su Chen knew very well that just because he could defeat the Void Core Realm, it did not mean that he could definitely suppress any Foundation Establishment Realm.
Some evil Foundation Establishment level warriors may not be inferior to myself in strength.
This is Donghuang Academy, and the fact that he has the third blood wheel will definitely not be spread out.
The Qilin Hammer appeared in his hand, turned into a shape of tens of feet, and hit Su Chen fiercely. The Qilin Hammer Blood Wheel itself is a powerful type of walking, the most direct hammer.
"Junior Su, be careful."
Using the Nine Tribulations Sword Technique to blend into the sword's blood wheel, the black-red sword shadow appeared in his hand and also struck out towards Tang Hao.
The sword hammer collided hard, causing waves to spread all around. The ground could not withstand the collision and began to shatter inch by inch.
The two of them stepped back at the same time. Su Chen only took one step back, but Tang Hao took six or seven steps back. His horrified eyes were full of shock. He never expected that Su Chen could survive.
He has full confidence in his own strength.
Not only can he sweep across the same level, but he can also kill enemies beyond the level. With the Qilin Hammer Blood Wheel in his hand, he can even defeat the fourth level Void Core Realm.
What now?
After taking several steps back, the first collision, technically speaking, he had lost, but he was unwilling to admit defeat.
"Let you see the Qilin Hammer Technique of our Tang Clan."
Like a ghost, he instantly disappeared from the spot, and the Qilin Hammer in his hand swung fiercely again, one hammer after another, and the continuous hammer shadow swept over the sky and covered the sky.
"My body is like a sword!"
Su Chen stood still, using the sword in his hand on the spot, and the dense and domineering sword energy formed a sword shield.
Bang!
Bang bang!
The sharp and domineering hammer shadow continued to bombard the sword guard, and the speed continued to soar.
Clenching her fists tightly and staring at the scene in front of her with worry, Junior Su must not have anything bad happen to her, otherwise, she will never feel at ease in her life.
A lifetime of guilt.
But she couldn't intervene. After all, she was not strong enough to compete with Tang Hao. She could only hope that Junior Su would win.
"Boy, I want to see how many of my blows you can withstand."
Bombarding like a sandstorm, the dense shadow of the hammer enveloped the sword cover. Su Chen could no longer be seen, only Tang Hao could be seen swinging the Qilin Hammer back and forth.
title_en: Chapter 22: Your attack is over, now it’s my turn. Chapter 23: Why should I stop in a life and death battle?
